Name: Unofficial Starblue Expanded Compatibility Fix
Author: runangiejar
Description:
[size=4]I'm making this mod because I'm currently playing Stardew Valley Expanded with Starblue, and I'm very grateful to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303]FlashShifter[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and to Lita ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral]strangelyliteral[/url]﻿) for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085?tab=files]Starblue Valley Unofficial for 1.6[/url] (Unofficial by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony?gameId=1303]CherrySymphony[/url])— they're both amazing and well-made mods, and I wanted to make them more compatible and immersive together.[/size]

[size=4]Textures are not complete yet, but 100% functional and much more immersive[/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]1. Needs: [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Blue Grass on Spring[/size][/b]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085?tab=files][size=3]Starblue Valley Unofficial for 1.6[/size][/url]﻿﻿
[/list][b][size=4]2. Just extract it to the mods folder and replace the files[/size][/b]

[b][size=5]3. Credits:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]***I didn't create the mods below, I just edited them so they are both (more) compatible, you need to install the mods (SVE and Starblue Valley Unofficial) first***[/size][/b]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303]FlashShifter[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085?tab=files]Starblue Valley Unofficial for 1.6[/url]: Lita: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral]strangelyliteral[/url]﻿, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony?gameId=1303]CherrySymphony[/url]﻿[/size]
﻿[/list]
